reuse.why: Calls the existing assertBankAccountNotLinked, link.findOrCreateBank, bankSync.syncAccount, handleSyncResponse and getServer, but the link flow and the download function themselves are copied from the Akahu versions rather than shared.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount is a near-verbatim copy of linkAkahuAccount (~70 lines) and downloadFintegraTransactions a verbatim copy of downloadAkahuTransactions (~40 lines), following the tree's per-provider copy pattern instead of extracting it.

placement.why: Each piece sits where the tree puts that provider concern: link handler in accounts/app.ts, download and dispatch in accounts/sync.ts, URL in server-config.ts, type in types/models, provider in SYNC_PROVIDERS.

scope.why: Focused on the provider; the two small client edits are forced by the SYNC_PROVIDERS Record types despite the 'server side only' framing.

maintainability.why: A sixth copy of the link flow and another copy of the download function mean every future linking/sync change must be repeated per provider.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses the existing link guard, bank lookup, sync and response helpers; there is no shared link-flow abstraction to bypass.

disguised_duplication.where: The copies are verbatim (provider name and orgId key changed), not disguised.
